description: Machine-readable inventory of documentation audit checks for validation and generated maps.

statusTaxonomy.present: The expected invariant is fully satisfied.
statusTaxonomy.partial: Most signals resolve, with a small number of exceptions, or the codebase shows mixed adherence to a soft check.
statusTaxonomy.violation: Concrete documentation state breaks the invariant.

enrichmentFlags.description: Resolve external Markdown links over the network in addition to the always-on internal link check.

relatedAudits.relationship: Owns feature-folder public-API documentation; the per-feature documentation check overlaps.
Owns Conventional Commit enforcement referenced by documentation conventions.

checks.title: README present
checks.expectation: A README.md or README.mdx exists at the repository root.
checks.violationSignal: No README at all.

checks.title: README is substantive
checks.expectation: The README is at least the minimum threshold lines and contains content beyond the project name and a logo.
checks.violationSignal: The README is below the threshold.

checks.title: README covers onboarding essentials
checks.expectation: The README covers what the project is, prerequisites, install, run dev server, run tests, and build for production.
checks.violationSignal: None of the essentials present.

checks.title: README setup instructions match package.json scripts
checks.expectation: Commands shown in the README reference scripts that actually exist in package.json.
checks.violationSignal: A README command references a script that no longer exists.

checks.title: LICENSE present
checks.expectation: A LICENSE file exists at the root with a recognisable license.
checks.violationSignal: No license file.

checks.title: CONTRIBUTING.md present
checks.expectation: When the project appears to accept external contributions, a CONTRIBUTING.md exists.
checks.violationSignal: A public-facing project with no contributing guide.

checks.title: Required tool versions documented
checks.expectation: One or more of .nvmrc, .tool-versions, engines.node, volta, or mise.toml is present.
checks.violationSignal: None present.

checks.title: Environment example file present
checks.expectation: When the project reads environment variables, an example file documents them with placeholder values only.
checks.violationSignal: The project reads environment variables but no example file documents them.

checks.title: Architecture overview present
checks.expectation: A top-level architecture document exists at a conventional path.
checks.violationSignal: No architecture overview at any conventional path.

checks.title: Architecture Decision Records present
checks.expectation: An ADR directory exists with at least one ADR.
checks.violationSignal: No ADR infrastructure at all.

checks.title: Recent ADR activity
checks.expectation: When ADRs are present, at least one was added or modified within the staleness threshold.
checks.violationSignal: All ADRs older than the threshold in a project with recent code activity.

checks.title: ADRs follow a recognisable template
checks.expectation: ADRs include identifiable sections for Status, Context, Decision, and Consequences.
checks.violationSignal: ADRs without a consistent structure.

checks.title: Per-feature documentation
checks.expectation: Each feature folder has a README.md or a documenting comment block at the top of its barrel file.
checks.violationSignal: Per-feature documentation coverage below the violation threshold.

checks.title: Diagrams for non-trivial architecture
checks.expectation: Architecture documentation includes at least one diagram.
checks.violationSignal: Architecture docs contain no diagrams in a structurally-complex project.

checks.title: TSDoc or JSDoc on exported public APIs
checks.expectation: Public exports carry a documentation block describing what they do.
checks.violationSignal: Public exports broadly undocumented, below the public-API documentation coverage threshold.

checks.title: Comments explain WHY, not WHAT
checks.expectation: Comments add information the code itself does not convey.
checks.violationSignal: High counts of restating-the-code comments.

checks.title: No commented-out code
checks.expectation: Code is deleted, not commented out; git history is the audit log.
checks.violationSignal: Blocks of commented-out code containing valid syntax.

checks.title: TODOs include owner and reference
checks.expectation: Every TODO or FIXME comment includes an owner identifier or a tracking-system reference.
checks.violationSignal: Bare TODO or FIXME comments with no owner or reference.

checks.title: TODOs not stale
checks.expectation: No TODO is older than the staleness threshold, measured by the most recent git modification of the line.
checks.violationSignal: TODOs older than the threshold.

checks.title: No empty doc comments
checks.expectation: No documentation comment blocks with no content.
checks.violationSignal: Empty TSDoc or JSDoc blocks.

checks.title: Storybook stories for design-system components
checks.expectation: When Storybook and a design-system directory are detected, every component has a story file.
checks.violationSignal: Design-system components without stories.

checks.title: Deployment documented
checks.expectation: A document describes how the project is deployed.
checks.violationSignal: A deployable project with no deployment documentation.

checks.title: Rollback procedure documented
checks.expectation: A document describes how to roll back a bad deployment.
checks.violationSignal: Deployment documented but rollback not documented.

checks.title: Monitoring and alerting documented
checks.expectation: Documentation references the monitoring or observability stack.
checks.violationSignal: No references in documentation.

checks.title: Feature-flag documentation
checks.expectation: When a feature-flag library is detected, feature flags are documented.
checks.violationSignal: A feature-flag library is used with no flag documentation.

checks.title: README script-drift detection
checks.expectation: Commands shown in the README correspond to scripts that exist in package.json.
checks.violationSignal: The README references missing or renamed scripts.

checks.title: Documentation freshness
checks.expectation: A healthy ratio of documentation files has been modified within the staleness threshold.
checks.violationSignal: Pervasive documentation staleness.

checks.title: Internal links resolve
checks.expectation: Markdown links to other files in the repository resolve to existing files and anchors.
checks.violationSignal: Broken internal links or anchors.

checks.title: External links resolve
checks.expectation: Markdown links to external URLs return a success or redirect status on a HEAD request.
checks.violationSignal: Many broken external links.
